items.exampleEn: This yummy soup takes only ten minutes to make.
items.exampleZh: 這道好喝的湯十分鐘就能煮好。

items.exampleEn: Fishing boats return to the port at dawn with boxes of prawns.
items.exampleZh: 漁船在清晨帶著一箱箱明蝦回到港口。

items.exampleEn: In this region, mutton is often cooked slowly with spices.
items.exampleZh: 在這個地區，羊肉常和香料一起慢火燉煮。

items.exampleEn: A ling has a long, thin body and can grow up to two meters long.
items.exampleZh: 長鱈的身體又細又長，最長可以長到兩公尺。

items.exampleEn: Aubergines turn soft and sweet when you roast them.
items.exampleZh: 茄子烤過之後會變得軟嫩香甜。

items.exampleEn: Some schools have stopped selling junk food in their shops.
items.exampleZh: 有些學校已經停止在福利社販售垃圾食物。

items.exampleEn: The chef cut the spareribs into small pieces before cooking.
items.exampleZh: 廚師在下鍋前把排骨切成小塊。

items.sentenceEn: These grilled prawns with garlic are the best thing on the menu.
items.sentenceZh: 這道蒜味烤明蝦是菜單上最好吃的。

items.audioEn: We're out of mutton today, but the beef stew is very good.
items.audioZh: 我們今天羊肉賣完了，不過燉牛肉很好吃。

items.sentenceEn: After the exam, we celebrated with pizza and other junk food.
items.sentenceZh: 考完試後，我們吃披薩和其他垃圾食物來慶祝。

items.sentenceEn: My dad grills spareribs in the backyard every summer.
items.sentenceZh: 我爸每年夏天都在後院烤排骨。

items.stemEn: These cookies are so ____ that my kids finished the whole box in an hour.
items.stemZh: 這些餅乾太好吃了，我家孩子一小時就把整盒吃光。

items.stemEn: The fishermen pulled a large ____ out of the deep, cold water.
items.stemZh: 漁夫們從寒冷的深海裡拉起一條大長鱈。

items.passageEn: My cousin from London visited us last summer, and we took her to a night market full of colorful lighting. At first, she pointed at a purple vegetable and called it an aubergine, and we all stared at her. She tried grilled prawns, fried spareribs and a spicy mutton soup. 'Yummy!' she said after every bite. At a fish stall, she was surprised to see ling, a fish she usually eats fried at home. Before we left, she bought a bag of junk food to share with her friends back in England. She said the market was like a giant cupboard full of new flavors.
items.passageZh: 我住在倫敦的表姊去年夏天來找我們，我們帶她去逛燈光繽紛的夜市。一開始，她指著一種紫色的蔬菜，叫它 aubergine，我們全都愣住了。她吃了烤明蝦、炸排骨和一碗辣羊肉湯。每吃一口她就說：「好好吃！」在一個魚攤，她很驚訝看到長鱈，那是她在家常吃的炸魚。離開前，她買了一袋垃圾食物，要帶回英國和朋友分享。她說夜市就像一個裝滿新口味的大櫥櫃。

questions.questionZh: 表姊一開始說了什麼，讓大家愣住？
options: 說她從來不吃辣的東西

questions.questionZh: 表姊在家通常怎麼吃長鱈？

items.promptZh: 這家餐廳的糖醋排骨很受歡迎。
referenceEn: The sweet and sour spareribs at this restaurant are very popular.
This restaurant's sweet and sour spareribs are really popular.
rubricZh: sparerib 通常用複數（例如 spareribs 等）
「糖醋」可寫，例如 sweet and sour 等；「很受歡迎」可寫，例如 very popular 等

referenceEn: Peeling prawns takes a lot of time.
It takes a long time to peel prawns.
rubricZh: prawn 指「明蝦、大蝦」，泛指時用複數 prawns
「剝殼」可寫，例如 peel、take the shells off 等
「很花時間」可寫，例如 takes a lot of time、It takes a long time to 等
